# Data register

**All documents in this folder are synthetic.** They were generated by
`scripts/generate_samples.py`. Company names, people, addresses, amounts and dates are
invented; every document starts with the banner
"SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DOCUMENT - CREATED FOR TESTING ONLY - NOT A REAL CONTRACT".
No production customer data, SharePoint or Microsoft 365 content is used.

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `samples/` | The 15 sample documents (7 TXT, 4 DOCX, 3 text PDF, 1 scanned image-only PDF) |
| `labels/` | Manual labels (answer key) - one JSON per document, format in `backend/schemas/labels.py` |
| `ground_truth_text/` | Exact source text of each sample (used to measure parser text recovery in Week 2) |
| `baseline/manual_timings.csv` | Minutes spent on manual extraction per document (fill in by hand) |

**Split rule:** extraction rules are developed and tuned only on the 10 `dev` documents.
The 5 `test` documents are held out and used only for reporting precision/recall.

## Permissions

- Source: generated in-house, synthetic. Approval needed: none for synthetic data;
  any real/anonymised KGIT document must be approved in writing by the mentor before it is
  added here.
- Label files have `"verified_by_human": false` until a reviewer checks them against the
  document and sets it to `true`.
